_readme: Attack ranges as tiles, because the wiki only documents them as in-game screenshots.
Each entry is a list of [column, row] offsets from the tile the Tatari stands on.
Column is positive to the right. Row is NEGATIVE towards the Zobos, because row 1
is the contact line at the top of the field and row 6 is nearest your base.
So [0, 0] is the Tatari's own tile, [0, -1] is one tile ahead of it, and
[-1, -2] is two ahead and one to the left. A positive row means a tile BEHIND the
Tatari, which a few of them do reach.
Range is a PER-FORM stat, unlike the Horde level-up skills. Evolving can change
the shape, not just the reach: Zappur covers three tiles straight ahead, but
Electroar one tier later covers a seven-tile T. So the default place for a new
entry is "bySlug", keyed by that one form's own slug.
"byLine" is only for a line you have checked form by form and found identical
all the way up. Its keys MUST be the tier-1 base form's slug, because the app
resolves a Tatari to its base form before looking there; a mid-line slug like
"electroar" is never found. "bySlug" wins over "byLine" for the same Tatari.
Most of these were read off data/images/range/<slug>.jpg by measuring the lit
tiles against the field grid, then checking each one against the diagram by eye.
Set "checked" to the name of whoever confirmed one in game.
Not listed here, and so showing no range rather than a guess: the 104 Tatari with
no range screenshot, the 8 whose diagram lights the whole board, and 34 where the
Tatari's own sprite hides whether the tile it stands on is lit. See the notes in
docs/ranges-todo.md for exactly which, and why.
Do not copy a sibling's tiles across on the assumption the line shares them.
